user_query: I'm organizing a music event and I need to book some popular artists. Can you suggest some top new artists from last year? Additionally, I'm curious about the radio stations on Deezer. Can you provide me with the details of a specific radio station?

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of popular new artists from the last year.
Select specific popular artists from the list to consider for booking.
Fetch the details of a specific radio station on Deezer.
